statement: This sketch creates an ethereal cosmic environment where translucent, slowly moving circles drift across a dark canvas in various cool shades of blue and purple. Faint, luminous trails flow through this space, leaving glowing paths behind them. When the drifting circles intersect with these trails, precise points of overlap flare brightly, creating momentary pulses of amplified light that illuminate the scene. The effect suggests a continuous, fluid motion where particles interact in subtle but visually striking ways, evoking a sense of deep space and perpetual cosmic flow.
